objective: Create an evidence-backed jurisdiction/compliance matrix for the Finance / NEXUS QUANT research and future execution path without inferring the Owner's personal jurisdiction or giving legal advice.
scope: Distinguish market-data licensing/redistribution obligations from trading/broker/exchange authorization
Define owner/entity jurisdiction verification as an explicit future Human Gate
Map representative major regulatory regimes using current official/primary sources
Record crypto-derivative, leveraged retail FX/CFD, broker/exchange authorization and marketing/access restrictions at a high level
Record data-use/storage/redistribution and index/exchange entitlement review requirements
Define provider/broker jurisdiction eligibility checklist and evidence fields
Reconcile stale supporting-task state and mark P01-D active
out_of_scope: Provide personalized legal, tax or investment advice
Infer Owner residence, nationality, citizenship, tax residency or professional-client status
Make final jurisdiction eligibility determination for the Owner
Select production provider, broker or exchange
Enable Demo, Shadow, Live or Auto Trading
tests: Every legal/regulatory claim has an official/primary source reference or is marked UNVERIFIED/TBD
Owner jurisdiction is not inferred from platform/account/location metadata
Market-data rights are separated from trading authorization
No final provider/broker/exchange selection is recorded
No personalized legal conclusion is recorded
security_tests: No personal jurisdiction or identity attributes inferred
evidence: Legal Data Hunter primary-source results where available
Official exchange/index licensing sources already canonical in P01-B
rollback: Revert P01-D research artifacts and state/catalog reconciliation only. No accounts, credentials, subscriptions or runtime changes are made.
definition_of_done: Owner-jurisdiction Human Gate fields are defined
Representative major regimes are documented with primary evidence
Market-data licensing and trading-authorization concerns are separated
Task Catalog and Current State are reconciled
